trades.detail: AUD swaps change floating index with maturity: quoted quarterly against 3M BBSW out to 3 years, semi-annual against 6M BBSW from 4 years. This trade sits in the 6M region and discounts on the RBA meeting-dated AONIA curve.

trades.label: 5Y AONIA OIS
trades.product: AUD OIS 5Y, payer 3.512% annual Act/365 vs compounded AONIA
trades.detail: AUD leg of the framework (T+1 Sydney settlement): the RBA meeting-dated AONIA strip bumped quote by quote. The RBA meets eight times a year, so the strip is coarser than the ECB's.
